intro.subtitle: The young merchant arrives in town...

menu.subtitle: The village awaits whenever you're ready.

restart.title: Restart the game?
restart.body: Your current progress will be lost and the story will start over from the intro.

interaction.empty: There's nothing to do here for now.

dialog.merchantGreeting: Welcome, traveler! Take a look at today's goods.
dialog.gatherGreeting: Everything is ready for harvest. Gather some {item}?
dialog.gatherDesc: The village resources belong to everyone.
dialog.ovenColdGreeting: The oven is cold and full of cobwebs... The merchant could help you build one.
dialog.ovenHotGreeting: The oven is hot! The smell of fresh bread fills the square.
dialog.bakeDesc: Grandma's recipe: patient dough and just enough firewood.

econ.ovenFirst: You need to build the oven first.

sell_apple.description: Red apples from the roadside tree.

sell_bread.label: Sell bread
sell_bread.description: Freshly baked bread. The aroma opens wallets!

buy_wood.label: Buy firewood
buy_wood.description: Dry firewood, perfect for feeding an oven.
